text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...
One day, Mejiro McQueen looked more tired than usual.

So after training, I decided to take her
to the cafeteria for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
Thanks to you, I feel a little more relaxed.
choice_data_list: Any idea what might be causing this fatigue?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Actually, last night, reviewing my study material
took a bit longer than expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I couldn't rely on my roommate Ikuno-san as I usually do, you see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whenever I get stuck while studying, Ikuno-san is usually the one who helps me out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
On top of being diligent,
she is someone who genuinely cares for others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However... I have a race coming up soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "As her friend, and as her rival, I want her to cherish her own dreams right now."
As I nodded along to Mejiro McQueen's story, saying, "I see"—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, Trainer-san.
Thank you for your hard work today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I thought I heard my name called just a moment ago. Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...!
It is nothing of great concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear...
If anyone finds out about that conversation...!"

Her thoughtful concern in wanting me to focus on the race would go to waste.
Is there a way to change the subject—
choice_data_list: I heard they're a good friend.
I heard they're a good friend.
You said you want to cherish your dream.
She said she wants to cherish your dream.

text_block_list.text:
Her thoughtful concern in wanting me to focus on the race would go to waste.
Is there a way to change the subject—
choice_data_list: I heard they're a good friend.
I heard they're a good friend.
You said you want to cherish your dream.
She said she wants to cherish your dream.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You mean... me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, if you want to put it that way,
McQueen-san, you're the one who is a wonderful friend.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I don't mean to speak out of turn, but—unlike certain people who tend to go wild even after being warned, McQueen-san is very receptive to advice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When I find myself in the position of watching over others,
it truly helps immensely.

Mejiro McQueen's earnestness and honesty—
those are traits that even I, as her Trainer,
can truly appreciate.
choice_data_list: I think I kind of understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so as well, Trainer!
As expected, McQueen-san is diligent,
hardworking, and absorbs everything so quickly—

...At an unexpected moment,
Ikuno Dictus's management theories
exploded forth.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that.
Thank you very much for the valuable conversation,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you have the time,
I would love to hear the rest of the story.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Good grief, really.
You two are getting way too worked up together."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind me. Ikuno-san,
please focus on your own matters.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But please don't worry,
I'm taking proper care of myself as well.
Mejiro McQueen grows bashful at the praise while Ikuno Dictus remains calm and collected. It felt like a glimpse into their usual dynamic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on, Trainer!
That's way too blunt...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "However, there is no need to worry. I am always careful not to exceed my capacity. More importantly—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Is McQueen-san feeling all right?
She seems somewhat exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-You don't need to worry about me either!
Really, I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so?
If it is unnecessary, I will say no more, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No, it's not that it's unnecessary, or anything like that...!
—Inside Mejiro McQueen, there seems to be a mix of gratitude and feeling apologetic for being fussed over so much.
choice_data_list: It seems she's embarrassed from being worried about too much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I did not say all that!
Kindly refrain from treating me like a child!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see... So that was it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Understood. In that case, I'll be careful not to smother you too much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hey, seriously...!
Not you too, Ikuno...!

In contrast to the flustered Mejiro McQueen,
Ikuno Dictus smiled calmly.
